product_type: Plant-based food from known ingredients (tofu, textured soy, gluten, jackfruit, do chay, plant milks)
route: Self-declaration (tu cong bo san pham) with lab test report within 12 months; food-safe facility; labelling
authority: Provincial authority designated by provincial People's Committee (MOH/MOIT/MAE sector split applies)
legal_basis: Law 55/2010; Decree 15/2018 Art 4-5; Decree 43/2017 as amended by 111/2021
documented_timeline: Sale allowed immediately after filing (no agency approval)
precedent_in_VN: Many (do chay brands, soy and nut milks)
open_questions: New Food Safety Law may convert some self-declaration into registration (direction shown by suspended Decree 46/2026 and Res 66.13/2026); no rule on meat/milk terms

product_type: Koji or traditional mould fermentation on a food substrate (A. oryzae, Rhizopus)
precedent_in_VN: Traditional products (tuong, nuoc tuong) exist; no alt-protein koji product verified
open_questions: Strain documentation expected by inspectors; mycotoxin testing
notes: Long history of use lowers Art 5(1) risk

route: Self-declaration is the only mechanism; no pre-approval route for the ingredient
authority: Provincial designated authority; VFA for guidance
legal_basis: Decree 15/2018 Art 4-5; risk under Law 55/2010 Art 5(1) and Art 55(1)(c)
open_questions: Would an inspector treat a new strain as 'not a food-type raw material' or a 'new-technology product not yet permitted'? No procedure to obtain permission
notes: Edible-mushroom species lower risk than novel strains (e.g. Fusarium venenatum)

route: (a) Self-declaration as food; or (b) registration as health supplement (thuc pham bao ve suc khoe)
documented_timeline: (a) immediate; (b) 21 working days at MOH plus GMP-certified plant
precedent_in_VN: Spirulina products on market (prior lead: Vinh Hao; not verified this wave)
open_questions: Novel species face same uncertainty as fungal biomass

route: Importer self-declares, or exempt if used only for own production; GM labelling if >5% of product; registration at VFA if used as additive not on MOH list
legal_basis: Decree 15/2018 Art 4(2), 6, 10; Decree 69/2010 as amended by 43/2026 (definition of product of GMO); Circular 24/2019
documented_timeline: Self-declaration immediate; additive registration 7 working days
open_questions: Does a purified recombinant protein need a GMO food-use certificate (Art 32-33) in addition to labelling? Import inspection mode under new law
notes: New definition covers products with 'protein from modified gene'

product_type: Precision-fermented protein food (made in Vietnam with GM microbe)
route: MAE certificate for GMO used in closed production (new Art 37a) + food route as above + environmental permit
authority: MAE Minister (closed production); provincial food authority; provincial environment authority
legal_basis: Decree 69/2010 Art 37a (added by Decree 43/2026); Decree 15/2018; Law on Environmental Protection and Decree 08/2022
open_questions: Art 37a dossier and timeline; whether MOH must also clear the product
notes: Also qualifies as priority high-tech (Decision 23/2026 items 60, 92) for CIT incentives

route: No workable route; theoretically self-declaration, but Law 55/2010 Art 55(1)(c) implies 'permission' for new-technology food with no procedure; GM cell lines add GMO issues
legal_basis: Law 55/2010 Art 5(1), 55(1)(c); Decree 69/2010 as amended; possible sandbox under Law 93/2025 Art 21
open_questions: Which ministry would approve a sandbox; whether new Food Safety Law will address it

product_type: Insect meal for livestock and poultry feed
route: Listed raw material ('con trung'): no trial; certified feed factory; declared standard and conformity (hop quy) vs QCVN 01-190:2020; label
authority: Provincial People's Committee chair (factory certificate); DLPAH (list)
legal_basis: Law on Animal Husbandry Art 32, 36, 38-39; Circular 21/2019 App VI I.1.2; QCVN 01-190:2020; Decree 136/2025; Decree 32/2026
documented_timeline: Factory certificate: 10 working days appraisal, 20 working days assessment, 5 working days issue (Decree 13/2020 Art 10, now provincial)
precedent_in_VN: Entobel (commercial plant 2019, Dat Do IZ, Ho Chi Minh City (former Ba Ria-Vung Tau))
notes: Insects are a benchmark, not a recommended play

route: Check aquafeed permitted list (Circular 16/2026 App II); if not listed: aquafeed trial then recognition
authority: DFFI (list); provincial chair (trial recognition, import licence)
legal_basis: Law on Fisheries Art 31, 35, 36; Decree 26/2019 Art 31-32; Decree 136/2025 Art 18-19; Circular 16/2026
documented_timeline: If trial needed: 20 days dossier appraisal + trial + 10 working days recognition
open_questions: Is insect meal on the aquafeed list?

route: Listed raw material ('beo' among aquatic plants): no trial for livestock; conformity vs QCVN 01-190:2020; certified factory
precedent_in_VN: Research only (prior lead: Can Tho 1990s); no commercial registration found
open_questions: Heavy metals and pathogens if grown on effluent; aquafeed listing unknown
notes: Food use of duckweed is a separate, uncertain food route

product_type: Yeast protein for feed (inactive yeast, Torula/Candida, molasses-grown yeast, amino-acid fermentation by-products)
route: Listed raw material since Feb 2023: no trial; conformity; certified factory
legal_basis: Circular 31/2022 amending Circular 21/2019 App VI; QCVN 01-190:2020
precedent_in_VN: Listed category shows MAE practice of adding fermentation-derived materials
open_questions: Aquafeed listing of yeast protein (beyond probiotic S. cerevisiae) unknown

product_type: Bacterial single-cell protein or new microbial biomass for livestock feed
route: New substance: feed trial under DLPAH-approved protocol, recognition, then addition to permitted list at annual update
authority: DLPAH (protocol, recognition, list); provincial chair (import licence for trial material; factory)
legal_basis: Law on Animal Husbandry Art 37; Circular 94/2025 Ch. III Art 13-14; Circular 21/2019 Art 6; Decree 32/2026
documented_timeline: Protocol: council within 15 working days + decision 5 working days; recognition 15 + 5 working days; trial length per protocol; list updated annually
open_questions: Whether recognition alone allows circulation before list update; whether foreign approvals can waive trial (Art 37(2) exempts recognised state research results)
notes: Total 6-18 months is an estimate, not documented

route: If not on aquafeed list: register trial (forms 17.NT-19.NT), run trial, results recognised; import licence for trial material; then declare aquafeed products
authority: Provincial chair (recognition, import licence); DFFI (list); trial facility meeting Decree 26/2019 Art 31
legal_basis: Law on Fisheries Art 31, 35, 36; Decree 26/2019 Art 31-32; Decree 136/2025 Art 18(2), 19(2); Circular 16/2026
documented_timeline: 20 days dossier appraisal; trial; 10 working days recognition
open_questions: Who now approves the trial protocol (DFFI or province)? Is SCP listed?
notes: Prior lead of 12-18 months not documented

product_type: New food additive, enzyme or processing aid (e.g. fermentation-derived)
route: Registration of product declaration at VFA for additives not on list or new uses; or MOH list amendment on request with safety evidence
open_questions: Enzyme/processing-aid pathway not visible in extract; GM-derived additive status
